data.subject: Your FCL Quote: Rotterdam to New York, 3 x 40GP
data.body:
Dear Customer,

Thank you for your quote request. Please find our offer for your FCL shipment below.

Lane: Rotterdam -> New York
Equipment: 3 x 40GP
Commodity: as described

All-in total: EUR 9890

For reference, this total is made up of the following charges:
- Base rate: EUR 2400 per container
- BAF: EUR 320 per container
- THC Rotterdam: EUR 225 per container
- THC New York: EUR 290 per container
- ISPS: EUR 25 per container
- Documentation: EUR 65 per shipment
- Export customs: EUR 45 per shipment

This quote is valid through 2026-12-31.

If you would like to proceed with a booking, or if you have any questions about this offer, please reply to this email and our team will be glad to help.

Kind regards,

Linkport Forwarders BV
